name: Motor Scooter
summary: Ink sketch step-through moped scooter with a front shield and small wheels, in side view facing right.

params.name: y
params.note: floor line: the tyres stand on y

params.name: s
params.note: room scale: about 520 px wide and 440 px tall at s = 1

params.name: anim
params.note: drive = wheels spin and the scooter bounces (also on when vx is not 0)

params.name: vx
params.note: horizontal speed in px per frame (negative = left; set flip too)

params.name: flip
params.note: mirror so the scooter faces left

author: krakujs
